title: Apple Refreshes the iMac with M6 Chip: World's Best All-in-One PC is About to Hit the Market
summary: The new Apple iMac with M6 brings up to 5x faster on-device AI and Wi-Fi 7. Compare it with the previous M4 model, see the November 6 release date, and learn what Bangladeshi buyers can expect.
intro: Apple unveils the new iMac with M6. See its specs, features, release date, and Bangladesh outlook.
html:
Apple has revealed the new Apple iMac M6, and it carries a brand-new M6 chip. The company says the machine sets a new bar for the all-in-one PC. This guide covers the new Apple M6 iMac features, specifications, and release plans. It also explains what Bangladeshi buyers can expect.

Table of Contents

  • When the New iMac is Releasing
  • New M6 iMac Specs and Features
  • Performance Upgrades from the Apple iMac with M6 Chip
  • Next-Gen Apple Intelligence & Siri
  • Display, Camera, and Design
  • Enhanced Connectivity and Ports
  • macOS 27 and iPhone Integration
  • Environmental Impact
  • iMac M4 vs iMac M6: How Practical the Upgrade Can Be
  • Who Should Upgrade?
  • Apple iMac with M6 Price and Features
  • Final Thoughts

“iMac is the world’s best all-in-one, and today it raises the bar yet again,” said Shelly Goldberg, Vice President of Hardware Engineering, Apple Inc. Her words set the tone for a launch that targets students, creators, and educators as well as busy households.

When the New iMac is Releasing

Apple sets the Apple iMac M6 release date for Friday, November 6, 2026. The timeline is simple; pre-orders start on October 28, and it is expected to be available from Friday, November 6, 2026. These dates come from Apple’s United States site. Bangladesh has no confirmed local date yet.

New M6 iMac Specs and Features

The new Apple M6 iMac features arrive in a thin, colorful body. Each upgrade targets speed, AI help, or daily comfort.

Performance Upgrades from the Apple iMac with M6 Chip

Raw speed leads the New Apple iMac with M6 performance upgrades. Apple claims up to 18x faster performance than the most popular Intel-based iMac. It also reports the world’s fastest single-threaded CPU performance.

The advanced GPU in M6 delivers 2x faster graphics than M4. That gain helps with photo editing and gaming with ray tracing. Besides, the storage runs up to 2x faster. Apps like Microsoft Excel run up to 2.5x faster than on an iMac with M1. They also run up to 1.5x faster than on M4.

From everyday productivity to creative workloads and AI tasks, the new superfast M6 feels faster. Users can also pick up to 32GB of unified memory.

Next-Gen Apple Intelligence & Siri

The new iMac offers a powerful platform for AI while preserving user privacy. Its first dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 2x faster AI compute than the previous generation. On-device AI can run up to 5x faster than on M4. That speed helps with running LLMs on the device. Apple adds more powerful AI capabilities across the new macOS too.

Buyers will be able to experience the next generation of Apple Intelligence with Siri AI. According to Apple, it is going to be deeply personal. It supports everyday workflows with built-in privacy for families, creative professionals, and small business owners.

For instance, the Apple iMac with M6 and Siri AI can draft text and match your tone in messages and mail. Spotlight also lets you ask Siri questions and follow up. Users can easily create an automation in Shortcuts with a simple text description. Across the new iMac, users can write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Beta access begins with macOS 27 in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. Usage limits may apply.

Display, Camera, and Design

The latest Apple iMac with M6 chip specifications start with a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display. It reaches 500 nits of brightness and supports P3 wide color with over a billion colors. An optional nano-texture glass finish cuts glare near windows and bright lights. Calls will sound and look good with its 12MP Center Stage camera, Desk View, studio mics, and six speakers.

The iMac comes in seven vibrant colors such as blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver. Buyers also get color-matched accessories like a keyboard and mouse or trackpad. Magic Keyboard with Touch ID ships with the 12-core CPU model. Shoppers can browse more Apple Accessories to complete the desk.

Enhanced Connectivity and Ports

Enhanced connectivity is a key win for this model. It supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. An optional 2.5Gb Ethernet port delivers up to 2.5x faster wired connectivity than the previous generation.

Buyers can also choose up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports. The 12-core CPU model supports two external 6K displays. Wi-Fi 7 availability varies by country, so Bangladeshi buyers should check local router support.

macOS 27 and iPhone Integration

Software gets a lift from the power of the new macOS 27. A new slider in Settings and an option to personalize Liquid Glass let users adjust the look. Spotlight can also run hundreds of actions. Meanwhile, iPhone Mirroring, Universal Clipboard, and calls and texts connect the iMac with an iPhone.

Environmental Impact

The new iMac meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. Apple made it with 40 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar. The box uses 100 percent fiber-based packaging. Apple also uses 15 percent recycled material by weight.

iMac M4 vs iMac M6: How Practical the Upgrade Can Be

Most iMac with M4 owners can wait, but heavy AI, graphics, and network users should consider the jump. Meanwhile, the upgrade is even better for Intel-based upgraders, and M1 owners also notice big gains. This table compares the key factors.

Key factor iMac with M4 iMac with M6
On-device AI Baseline Up to 5x faster
Neural Engine 16-core Dual 16-core, up to 2x faster AI compute
Graphics Baseline Up to 2x faster
Storage Baseline Up to 2x faster
Wired network Gigabit Ethernet 2.5Gb Ethernet option, up to 2.5x faster
Wireless Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3 Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6
Excel-type apps Baseline Up to 1.5x faster
Display and colors 24-inch 4.5K, seven colors Same

Display size, brightness, and the seven colors stay the same on both models. Therefore, the upgrade focuses on speed, AI, and networking rather than looks.

Who Should Upgrade?

Owners of an iMac with M4 gain the most from AI speed, graphics, and faster networking. Users who only browse and send email will see smaller gains. iMac users who value portability can compare a MacBook instead. Fans of Apple HomeView and other Apple gear can keep everything in one ecosystem.

Apple iMac with M6 Price and Features

The price of the iMac M6 is $1499; however, the pricing for Bangladesh is not public yet. Local prices depend on the model, exchange rate, and import costs. When available, buyers should choose an authentic device with a valid warranty from trusted retailers. For local buying, choose the Star Tech online shop in Bangladesh.

Is the iMac M6 worth upgrading to from the iMac M4?

For most M4 owners, the upgrade can still wait. Meanwhile, the heavy AI, graphics, and network users gain the most, with up to 5x faster on-device AI. Intel-based owners will see up to 18x faster performance.

Does the Apple iMac with M6 support Siri AI?

Yes. Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI, which drafts text, answers questions in Spotlight, and builds Shortcuts from a text description. Beta access starts in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.

What colors does the new iMac come in?

The iMac comes in seven colors: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver. Color-matched accessories are available too.

Does the iMac with M6 support Wi-Fi 7?

Yes. It supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, though Wi-Fi 7 availability varies by country.

How much memory can buyers choose?

Buyers can choose up to 32GB of unified memory.

Does the display have an anti-glare option?

Yes. Apple offers an optional nano-texture glass finish that reduces reflections.

Final Thoughts

The iMac with M6 Apple Silicon 2026 model mixes speed, smart AI tools, and a bright display. It gives Intel-based owners a huge jump and gives M4 owners a smaller, focused gain. Bangladeshi buyers now have a clear reason to watch this launch.
